decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy builds on the firm's existing psychosocial care knowledge and its increasing website prominence indicates the firm can interpret and learn from early results.
Counseling for senior living is highly related to the firm's core residential care expertise and has been consistently featured on the home page, signaling strong fit and positive learning.

The retail shop from the sheltered workshop leverages existing workshop infrastructure and client relationships, and its move to the home page suggests the firm has successfully assimilated retail knowledge.

Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the firm's core care and can use its knowledge of senior nutrition and client base, but its only mentioned status leaves moderate uncertainty about early learning.
